title: DiscoveryFrontier
description: The durable DFS stack for one discovery pass. Discovery runs before a decomposition boundary (Root→Goals, Goal→Sprints, Sprint→Tasks, Task→impl) whenever the triage flags uncertainty. One file per node at plan/discovery/<node-id>/frontier.json; full answers live in sibling Q<NN>.md files, the decision-ready synthesis in findings.md. This is to discovery what plan/state.json is to execution. See docs/discovery-phase.md.

node.description: The tree node this discovery pass serves: 'root', a goal 'G<n>', a sprint 'G<n>-S<m>', or a task 'G<n>-S<m>-T<k>'.

status.description: discovering = frontier still being worked; gated = passed to the discovery-gate; done = gate passed, findings ready to decompose; escalated = a budget cap was hit and the pass is inconclusive (NEVER a clean exit).

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the last mutation of this frontier.

budget.description: Backstop caps against runaway search. Hitting any cap forces status 'escalated' — it is a safety net, not a clean stop. Most branches should terminate by decision-relevance (leaf_reason), not by budget.

token_cap.description: Approximate token budget for the whole pass before escalation.

tokens_spent.description: Approximate tokens consumed so far, compared against budget.token_cap by the budget check.

questions.description: Every question in the DFS tree, open and resolved. Ordering in the file is not significant; DFS pop order is driven by weight among status='open' questions.

id.description: Canonical question id (e.g. Q3). Unique within this frontier.

parent.description: The question whose answer spawned this one, or null for a triage-seeded root question.

depth.description: Distance from a triage-seeded root (root questions are depth 0). Compared against budget.max_depth.

weight.description: constraint_weight — how much this question's answer is expected to prune or change the plan. The DFS pops the highest-weight open question first.

status.description: open = awaiting an answer; answered = resolved (leaf or with children); pruned = subsumed by a sibling's answer (see pruned_by); inconclusive = hit a budget cap.

answer_ref.description: Relative path to the Q<NN>.md file holding the full answer + evidence cites. Null until answered.

children.description: Child question ids spawned by this question's answer. Empty for a leaf.

leaf_reason.description: Why this answered question spawned no children — i.e. why it is decision-stable. Required reading for the gate, which uses it to catch premature stops. Null unless the question is an answered leaf.

pruned_by.description: The id of the question whose answer subsumed this one. Set only when status='pruned'. The gate uses it to catch over-eager prunes.
